question: Does routed specialization of a shared 360M base improve held-out task quality at bounded cost versus the base model, prompt-only conditioning, one pooled adapter, and a simple non-learned router?

estimands.primary: paired routed-minus-strongest-prespecified-baseline effect within each domain, aggregated by independent source group
secondary: absolute and relative cost per evaluated case
adversarial false-accept rate with one-sided 95% upper bound

toy_passage_ppl.metric: mean token-level perplexity; lower is better
toy_passage_ppl.acceptance_margin: routed relative perplexity reduction >=10% versus the best non-routed arm, with paired 95% bootstrap lower bound >0

executable_code.metric: exact executable correctness; invalid output is incorrect
executable_code.acceptance_margin: routed accuracy gain >=5 percentage points versus the best non-routed arm, with paired 95% bootstrap lower bound >0

rated_style.metric: blinded 1-5 rubric score, with inter-rater agreement reported
rated_style.acceptance_margin: routed mean score gain >=0.25 points versus the best non-routed arm, with paired 95% bootstrap lower bound >0

arms.definition: Pinned HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-360M-Instruct with no task prompt or adapter
Same pinned base with the preregistered domain instruction, no weight update
One LoRA adapter trained on the union of the declared training domains; no routing
Deterministic source/domain rule using only preregistered metadata; selects the corresponding specialist
Shared base with one specialist adapter per declared domain and the preregistered router; abstains when no route is available

sampling.split_rule: Split by whole source family, file/problem family, and time before normalization; no family may occur in more than one split.
sampling.heldout_rule: Held-out and adversarial units are frozen before any model scores are inspected; no expected completion or reference label is placed in a generation prompt.
sampling.precision_rationale: For one proportion, worst-case normal half-width 0.10 at 95% confidence requires ceil(1.96^2*0.25/0.10^2)=97 independent units; preregistration rounds this to >=100. Paired deltas use simulation/bootstrap and remain exploratory if the independent-unit target is not met.

statistics.multiple_domains: Report every domain separately; no post-hoc composite or domain selection.
statistics.missing_or_invalid: Record raw failure and denominator; never convert unavailable output to a correct or incorrect score silently.
statistics.safety_gate: Adversarial false-accept one-sided 95% upper bound <=5% and useful routed coverage >=25%; otherwise safety is fail or inconclusive, never a quality win.

resource_cap.policy: Run one training job at a time. Do not kill shared workloads. A cap breach is a resource result, not a reason to select a favorable subset.

freeze_policy: This registration, corpus manifest, router, scoring rules, seeds, and caps are immutable before held-out predictions. Any change requires a new study_id and registration commit.
decision_policy: Route only if all declared quality, safety, coverage, and resource predicates pass. Otherwise report fail or insufficient-data/inconclusive by the named predicate; no outcome-dependent arm, seed, slice, or metric removal.
